lines.text: Unlock your best semester with a hands-on workshop designed to
In 60 minutes, we'll cover proven strategies to give you a boost,
including effective time management, efficient note-taking, active
recall, interval-based study, and strategic exam preparation. You'll
practice building a weekly learning plan, breaking down large
assignments, and tracking progress with simple tools.
We'll also highlight campus resources—including tutoring, the
Writing Center, advising, and peer mentoring—so you'll know
exactly where to get support when you need it. Bring your syllabi
and a laptop or notebook; you'll leave with a personalized study
plan you can start using immediately.
• Open to all registered students—undergraduate & graduate
• Questions? Contact Liz Parker at Iparker@bledmorecollege.edu
